text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx rate detected for inference-us-east-1a (model-serving). Auto-escalation to SRE oncall.

alice.sre: seeing steady 5xxs ~12% over last 3m, tail latency spikes too. Metrics: error_rate=0.12, p99=2.3s. paging now.

raj.runtime: I can see repeated socket timeouts to g5 instances in us-east-1a, also some ENI detach logs. suspect NIC flaps or host networking issues.

emily.platform: confirmed host-level syslogs show NIC rx-drop bursts. AWS console shows instance-status degraded for a small subset in the AZ.

carlos.cs: any customer impact so far? CS flagging a handful of customers with spike in errors and slow responses. one on a dedicated pool saw 30% request failures.

alice.sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic away from us-east-1a via routing policy to us-east-1b 2) failover traffic for Dedicated pools to reserved fallback nodes 3) open oncall handoff for longer work. will coordinate.

nora.oncall: starting traffic reroute now. applying policy: route-pref=secondary for region us-east-1a.

deploy-bot: runbook step executed: traffic-shift command: 
```
redwood-route set-preference --region us-east-1 --from-az us-east-1a --to-az us-east-1b --weight 90
```

alice.sre: routing change is live. seeing drop in 5xx from 12% -> 3% in the external metrics stream. still some errors for stateful sessions (sticky sessions hitting degraded hosts).

raj.runtime: for sticky sessions, we're enabling model-variant fallback to smaller KV-cache-friendly binaries to avoid long replays. patching runtime flag: `enable-session-fallthrough=true`.

amanda.eng: deploying a quick instance drain for degraded hosts in us-east-1a and rebalancing pods. command snippet: 
```
kubectl drain node/g5-az1a-012 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

alice.sre: good. adding customer impact note for status page. draft: "We are experiencing increased error rates for inference requests in US‑East (single AZ). Traffic is being routed to healthy capacity, mitigation in progress. No data loss reported."

carlos.cs: will send targeted customer DM to the affected dedicated pools. tagging top tier customers. need ETA on full recovery?

raj.runtime: after draining and fallback, service p95 latency back near baseline. need to monitor K/V cache warmup — some requests will be slower for first few minutes. ETA for stable: ~20–30m.

nora.oncall: handing off to alice.sre for next shift rotation. I'll remain available for 15m. on-call Handoff: issue=networking-az-us-east-1a, mitigation=traffic-reshuffle+drain+fallback, severity=high, customer-impact=partial-5xxs.

alice.sre: taking handoff. next steps: coordinate with cloud provider to investigate host NIC errors (open ticket), run a slow canary to ensure no regression, and prepare rollback for routing if downstream systems see overload.

emily.platform: opened AWS ticket 1234567890 with EC2 support, referenced ENI detach storms and degraded instance status. attaching logs and timestamps.

deploy-bot: canary test report: 1000 requests -> 0.5% errors, p99 450ms. no regressions observed.

carlos.cs: status page updated and customer DMs sent. customers acknowledged — asking for a formal incident summary when resolved.

alice.sre: marking this thread for follow-up postmortem. include: cause (suspected NIC firmware/host OS bug + localized capacity pressure), mitigation timeline (traffic reroute at +3m, drain started +6m, fallback enabled +8m), and customer impact list.

raj.runtime: adding one more note — we saw that autoscaling in us-east-1b absorbed extra load but required a ~60s scale-up delay. recommend pre-warming or transient credit for cross-AZ bursts. I'll add a ticket to Optimize for next sprint.

nora.oncall: resolved for pager rotation. leaving notes in incident log and tagging postmortem owners. :thumbsup:

alice.sre: last check: 5xxs trending <1% for region, p99 stable. closing urgent mitigation. keeping monitoring rules elevated for 2h. will draft next steps for postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, severity downgraded to "mitigated". follow-up required: postmortem owner=alice.sre, scribe=emily.platform, customer comms=carlos.cs.

alice.sre: acknowledged. leaving thread open for PM notes and postmortem link. thanks everyone for quick response.
